newsitem.title: INDIA: India Ranbaxy 96/97 1st half net at 718 mln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India Ranbaxy 96/97 1st half net at 718 mln rupees.

text.p: India's Ranbaxy Laboratories Ltd said its net profit rose to 718 million rupees in the six months to September 30, 1996 from 595 million a year ago, a company statement said on Tuesday.
It said the company recorded sales of 5.1 billion rupees in 1996/97 (Apr-Sept) against 4.2 billion in the same period last year.
Ranbaxy Laboratories recorded export sales growth of 2.45 billion rupees in the first half of 1996/97 from 1.74 billion a year-ago period.
The statement quoted Ranbaxy chairman Parvinder Singh as saying that the pharmaceutical company was poised for a sustainable growth.
